_note: Texts and resources from staged sourcing groups (tools/merge-sources.py). Links to the publisher only; never rehosted.

resources.title: Kundalini Yoga — Swami Sivananda (DLS free ebook)
resources.note: Swami Sivananda's Kundalini Yoga, free from the DLS publishing house. Syllabus target: theory chapters + practice schedule (NORTHSTAR endgame).

resources.title: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda (Wikisource)
resources.note: Nine-volume Complete Works. Syllabus target for the ramakrishna-order track; pairs with Belur Math + Advaita Ashrama places (08).

resources.title: AN 5.57: Subjects for Contemplation (Thanissaro translation)
resources.note: The five remembrances — already the source of a hub practice; recorded here as a text so syllabuses can cite it.

resources.title: Dhammapada (Buddharakkhita translation, Access to Insight)
resources.note: Buddharakkhita's Dhammapada with introduction — the most-assigned first Buddhist text.

resources.title: Access to Insight — Theravada library
resources.note: Theravada sutta library: suttas, study guides, chanting guides. Entry point, not a single text.

resources.title: SuttaCentral — Early Buddhist Texts
resources.licence: free translations (SuttaCentral, various licences per text)
resources.note: Early Buddhist texts in Pali, Chinese, Sanskrit and Tibetan parallels with modern translations. Entry point.

resources.title: Buddhist Publication Society — free booklets
resources.note: BPS Wheel and Bodhi Leaves booklets, many free. Pairs with the BPS free-book resource already in the graph.

resources.title: Notes on Dhamma — Ñāṇavīra Thera (free edition)
resources.note: Notes on Dhamma + letters, free PDFs on site. Print: Path Press Clearing the Path / Seeking the Path (paid, linked as publisher). Pairs with nanavira-thera figure + Hillside lineage.

resources.title: Path Press — Ñāṇavīra collected writings
resources.licence: publisher shop (paid print, free site content)
resources.note: Publisher of the Ñāṇavīra collected writings; site carries essays and letters free. Entry point, not a single text.
